subject: the gate of a coaching inn in a small fantasy town
camera: The camera stands at eye level (1.6 m) in a gap between two tall buildings, on the cobbles in front of the inn's gate arch, looking east out of the town.

bearings.ahead: the way out of the town between the two buildings, cobbles giving way to a cart track, and beyond it hedgerows and cultivated fields in mid-green and yellow-green patchwork running away to the horizon
bearings.right: the Golden Dragon rising close and high: a building half again as large as its neighbours, a gate arch through to an inner courtyard with a carved and painted dragon sign hanging from an iron bracket above it, steep dark blue-grey slate roof over pale lime plaster and dark oak framing
bearings.behind: the market street running back into the town between three-storey timber-framed houses, upper storeys jettied out over the street
bearings.left: the end wall of the house opposite the inn, in shadow, a stable door and a mounting block, a cart with its shafts down
bearings.up: sky in the slot between the two buildings, the inn's eaves and stone chimneys on one side and the neighbour's slate on the other
bearings.down: worn grey granite cobbles rutted by cart wheels, straw trodden in near the gate arch

allowText: the inn's hanging sign may carry the words GOLDEN DRAGON in a medieval painted script; nothing else in the image carries lettering
